## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4005. The 502 Bad Gateway errors were caused by storefront-web version 3.0 introducing an OpenTelemetry dependency that cannot connect to the collector service in the observability namespace. When the telemetry export queue fills up, the application becomes unresponsive to requests. The fix is to either ensure the OpenTelemetry collector is available, disable telemetry export via environment variables, or configure the application to handle telemetry failures gracefully without blocking request handling.
